name: Postman public API network (public workspace / collection search)
tier_rationale: Postman, Inc. is an established company with published terms, a privacy policy and a business offering (A8 trusted); P069 chair rationale: 'Tier community for APIs.guru (Postman is trusted)'.

reliability.justification: Postman's own public search index: accurate about what is published, but the search is fuzzy (a random token still returns hits, same-named workspaces of unrelated users) and the endpoint is an undocumented website API that may change; only hits tied to the target by publisher or request host are kept (P069 cond 3).

public_search.title: Postman public workspace / collection / request search: POST www.postman.com/_api/ws/proxy (service search, path /search-all, domain public) - metadata only

terms.quote: Postman's search is an undocumented website API: terms 'unknown', so the Postman source stays disabled in every profile until legal records its terms (A1); meanwhile the Postman public search page is a manual pivot link.

public_search.notes: Quote: binding council text (P069 cond 2). Research C0636 (verified_live 200 from a datacenter egress, 2026-11-25/26); prep live checks 2026-11-26: 200 JSON in 0.3-0.8 s, no rate-limit headers, Cloudflare + CloudFront, identical answers with and without the web app's Origin/Referer (not sent). Queries are limited to org_profile domains and brands, at most 2 pages (body.from += 25) per query and a per-case query cap; hits not tied to the target by publisher or request host are discarded (P069 cond 3, 5). Responses are never cached (they can carry third-party secrets in request URLs); only redacted metadata is kept (P069 cond 4). The quota block is the module team's own politeness budget (observed, not published). Used by public_api_exposure.

api.title: Postman API api.getpostman.com (workspaces, collections, environments; X-Api-Key) - deep mode, deferred

terms.quote: No collection/environment downloads: deep mode is deferred to BACKLOG.md.

api.notes: Quote: binding council text (P069 cond 1). Registered so the host has an owner; no module uses it in this build (deep mode deferred: docs/backlog/p3-G03-1.md). Its key (V3LUM_POSTMAN_KEY) is not registered until deep mode is approved.

notes: Owned by batch p3-G03-1 (P069 public_api_exposure). www.postman.com serves the undocumented public search API and the manual search page (pivot pack public_api_exposure: postman_search); postman.com is the apex of the same site; api.getpostman.com is the keyed Postman API of the deferred deep mode. bbot's Postman modules (AGPL-3.0) were not copied: the request was rebuilt from the research record (P069 cond 6).
